mapper.select: SELECT c.routepost_comment_id AS routepostCommentId, c.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, c.routepost_id AS routepostId, c.routepost_content AS routepostContent, TO_CHAR(c.routepost_regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS routepostRegdate, c.routepost_comment_report_count AS routepostCommentReportCount, c.comment_status AS commentStatus FROM tblRoutePostComment c JOIN tblUser u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.routepost_id = #{routepostId} AND c.comment_status = 'A' ORDER BY c.routepost_regdate ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tblRoutePostComment ( routepost_comment_id, user_id, routepost_id, routepost_content, routepost_regdate, routepost_comment_report_count, comment_status ) VALUES ( seqRoutePostComment.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{routepostId}, #{routepostContent}, SYSDATE, 0, 'A' )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblRoutePostComment WHERE routepost_id = #{routepostId} AND comment_status = 'A'
